trials.claim: Tier 1 includes lifetime access to Writeseed - AI Content Writer
trials.claimQuote: Lifetime access to Writeseed - AI Content Writer
trials.reasoning: The binding terms allow termination at any time without warning in the vendor's sole discretion, and a buyer reports their account was deleted after a bad review, so lifetime access is not guaranteed.

exhibits.quote: WE MAY TERMINATE YOUR USE OR PARTICIPATION IN THE SERVICES OR DELETE YOUR ACCOUNT AND ANY CONTENT OR INFORMATION THAT YOU POSTED AY ANY TIME, WITHOUT WARNING, IN OUR SOLE DISCRETION.
exhibits.argument: The vendor reserves the right to terminate accounts at any time without warning, which voids any promise of lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: OWNER DELETED MY ACCOUNT BECAUSE I LEFT A BAD REVIEW.
exhibits.argument: A buyer who paid for codes reports the owner deleted the account, showing lifetime access can be taken back.

trials.claim: Tier 2 includes lifetime access to Writeseed - AI Content Writer
trials.claimQuote: Lifetime access to Writeseed - AI Content Writer
trials.reasoning: The terms reserve the right to deny access without notice or liability, and a two-code buyer reports their account was deleted after refusing to remove a review, contradicting guaranteed lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: WE RESERVE THE RIGHT TO, IN OUR SOLE DISCRETION AND WITHOUT NOTICE OR LIABILITY, DENY ACCESS TO AND USE OF THE SERVICES
exhibits.argument: The vendor can deny access for any reason without liability, which undermines guaranteed lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: I PAID FOR 2 CODES AND HE ASKED ME TO REMOVE THE REVIEW AND HE DELETED MY ACCOUNT WHEN I DECLINED.
exhibits.argument: A two-code buyer reports losing access after refusing to remove a bad review, contradicting lifetime access.

trials.claim: Writeseed turns links, PDFs and more into posts with custom tone for LinkedIn and blog growth on autopilot
trials.claimQuote: Grow your LinkedIn and blog on autopilot by turning links, PDFs, and more into posts with your custom tone
trials.reasoning: Buyers report the brand voicing/custom tone does not work at all and WordPress interaction is poor, materially undercutting the claimed custom-tone LinkedIn and blog autopilot, despite the vendor's marketing statements.

exhibits.quote: just to find out the brand voicing isn't working at all.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports the custom brand voice feature does not work, undermining the custom tone claim.

exhibits.quote: I dislike the fact is that it is not well-interacting with wordpress.
exhibits.argument: Poor WordPress interaction undermines the claim of blog growth on autopilot.

exhibits.quote: Generate LinkedIn posts that get likes and attention
exhibits.argument: Vendor advertises LinkedIn post generation, supporting the LinkedIn growth part of the claim.

exhibits.quote: Writeseed writes authentic content in your own voice. Write, design, and schedule posts in one place.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states it writes content in your own voice, supporting the custom tone part of the claim.

trials.claim: Writeseed provides over 70 AI templates for blog posts, Facebook ads, Google Ads and other content types
trials.claimQuote: Writeseed provides over 70 AI templates for various content types, including blog posts, Facebook ads, and Google Ads.
trials.reasoning: The vendor lists 100+ standard templates and a buyer confirms a wide range of templates; the prosecution exhibits only complain about limited model choice, not the number or existence of templates.

exhibits.quote: Many of the templates don't let you pick a LLM or have very limited LLM supports.
exhibits.argument: Many templates are reported as limited in model choice, undermining the value of the template library.

exhibits.quote: No Hendrik, the latest AI models ARE NOT OFFERED for ALL THE TEMPLATES.
exhibits.argument: Latest AI models are not offered across all templates, limiting the claimed template functionality.

exhibits.quote:
Chrome extension

-

100+ Standard Templates

-

Linkedin & Wordpress Integrations

-

Custom Brand Voices
exhibits.argument: Vendor lists 100+ Standard Templates as included, which supports providing over 70 templates.

exhibits.quote: I particularly like the long-form article writer, SEO optimization, paraphrasing tools, AI image generation, and the wide range of templates.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the product has a wide range of templates including long-form article writing.

trials.claim: AI article writer can generate full-length articles exceeding 1,500 words with free stock photos
trials.claimQuote: It features an AI article writer capable of generating full-length articles exceeding 1,500 words, complete with free stock photos.
trials.reasoning: Buyers confirm blog writing of 1,000-2,500 words and articles written out with matching images, supporting articles over 1,500 words with images; complaints about image quality or AI-image options do not show stock photos are absent.

exhibits.quote: You do not have option to generate image with AI in article writer.
exhibits.argument: The article writer reportedly lacks image generation, contradicting the stock photos claim.

exhibits.quote: The pics created in the articles are horrible.
exhibits.argument: Article images are reported as horrible quality, undermining the free stock photos benefit.

exhibits.quote: the SEO optimized blogpost writing that can range between 1000-2500 words
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the blog writer produces 1000-2500 words, supporting exceeding 1,500 words.

exhibits.quote: it suggests good headlines, helps me outline the article, and then writes it out with images and tables that actually match the topic.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms articles are written out with matching images, supporting images with articles.
